thread:
olivia g: Hey team, I lost my physical insurance card while on a trip. Need a quick PDF for the urgent care here. Can someone help?

people-ops: Sorry to hear that. Which plan are you on (Standard/Plus)? We'll get you a temp ID.

olivia g: Plus. I'm in Portland for the day and the urgent care clinic wants a copy before billing.

luis (benefits): Hi Olivia  we can generate a temporary ID PDF and email it. Do you want it sent to your personal or Redwood email? Also confirm member last 4 via DM.

olivia g: Sent last 4 via DM. Please email to my personal so clinic can accept it.

people-ops-bot: Upload link: https://benefits.redwood-inc/id-cards. For urgent requests use the "temp ID" button and choose email delivery. Typical delivery <15 minutes.

luis (benefits): Got the DM. Temp PDF emailed to personal address just now. It includes the carrier phone and member ID masked. Let us know if clinic needs anything else (billing NPI, prior auth reference).

olivia g: Received the PDF, clinic accepted it and is treating me. Thanks! Quick Q: if they bill OON at checkout, how do I submit for reimbursement?

luis (benefits): If paid OOP, upload receipt, itemized bill, and EOB (if any) to the claims portal: https://benefits.redwood-inc/claims-upload. Mark as "urgent travel" if time sensitive. We'll create intake ticket and file for reimbursement or appeal as appropriate.

olivia g: Perfect. Appreciate the fast help. :thumbsup:

people-ops-bot: Ticket created: BP-TRV-178200-01. Expected intake response within 2 business days.
